name: analytics-web
title: Web analytics
description: A glass web analytics dashboard template for React: visitors, sources, pages and countries with a time-range picker, rolling KPIs and a live mode. MIT.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Web analytics: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/dashboards/web-analytics

Installed in components/sheenui/blocks/. Import (use your components alias):
import { WebAnalyticsDashboard } from "@/components/sheenui/blocks/analytics-web";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
